WITH base AS (SELECT * FROM span_rollup WHERE "bucket" >= ?::TIMESTAMP_NS AND "bucket" < ?::TIMESTAMP_NS AND ((namespace = 'shop'))) SELECT epoch_ms(time_bucket(INTERVAL '60 seconds', "bucket"::TIMESTAMP_NS))::BIGINT AS "_t", 100.0 * coalesce(sum(spans) FILTER (WHERE status='STATUS_CODE_ERROR'),0) / nullif(sum(spans),0) AS "error_rate" FROM base GROUP BY time_bucket(INTERVAL '60 seconds', "bucket"::TIMESTAMP_NS) ORDER BY "_t" LIMIT 14000

WITH base AS (SELECT * FROM span_rollup WHERE "bucket" >= ?::TIMESTAMP_NS AND "bucket" < ?::TIMESTAMP_NS AND ((namespace = 'shop'))) SELECT epoch_ms(time_bucket(INTERVAL '60 seconds', "bucket"::TIMESTAMP_NS))::BIGINT AS "_t", coalesce(sum(spans),0) / nullif(greatest(0.0, (least(1791402300000000000::BIGINT, epoch_ns(time_bucket(INTERVAL '60 seconds', "bucket"::TIMESTAMP_NS))+60000000000::BIGINT)-greatest(1791398700000000000::BIGINT,epoch_ns(time_bucket(INTERVAL '60 seconds', "bucket"::TIMESTAMP_NS))))/1000000000.0),0) AS "rate" FROM base GROUP BY time_bucket(INTERVAL '60 seconds', "bucket"::TIMESTAMP_NS) ORDER BY "_t" LIMIT 14000

WITH base AS (SELECT * FROM spans WHERE "start_time" >= ?::TIMESTAMP_NS::TIMESTAMPTZ_NS AND "start_time" < ?::TIMESTAMP_NS::TIMESTAMPTZ_NS AND ((namespace = 'shop')) AND ((kind IN ('SPAN_KIND_SERVER', 'SPAN_KIND_CONSUMER')))) SELECT coalesce("operation", '') AS "operation", quantile_cont("duration_ms", 0.95)::DOUBLE AS "p95" FROM base GROUP BY "operation" ORDER BY "p95" DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 400
